levels.title: Check the smallest cases
levels.body_md: Look closely at your if condition and think about very small weights. What happens when the weight is even but too small to split into two parts?
levels.question_back: What happens with the smallest even weight?

levels.title: Positive evens need minimum sum
levels.body_md: Each part must be positive and even, so each part needs a minimum size. Think about what that implies for the total weight.

levels.title: Your check misses size limit
levels.body_md: Your test in `L6` with `w % 2 == 0` checks only parity and forgets size. For input `2` your program prints `YES` but the expected output is `NO`.

levels.title: Require parity plus enough weight
levels.body_md: Two positive even parts must each be at least 2, so the total must be at least 4. Your version accepts every even `w`, so it wrongly accepts the too-small even case. Fix it by keeping your parity test in `L6` and also requiring `w` to be larger than 2. This stays `O(1)` time and memory.
